g.text: 6. notify: channel checked first, alerts sent after the run
notifier misconfigured: exit code 2, before anything else
TWS unreachable (connection error or timeout): exit code 1
The gates are the preset's quality gates plus its trap detection rules.

text.tspan: 1. snapshot: every managed account's open positions
and cash by currency
idempotent per (snapshot_date, account):
delete that day's rows of the account,
then insert into portfolio_snapshots and cash_balances;
other accounts' rows of the day untouched
market value = quantity × latest close, expressed in the position's currency
latest close = newest prices_daily close on or before the snapshot date,
in its listing currency; when that differs from the position's currency:
close × rate_to_usd of the listing currency ÷ rate_to_usd of the position's currency,
nearest prior rates from currencies
either currency unknown: close used as is
no close, close ≤ 0, or a missing or non-positive rate:
market value empty (unpriced)
2. corporate actions, best effort
only when BOT_IBKR_FLEX_TOKEN and BOT_IBKR_FLEX_QUERY_ID are set
dividend cash transactions → dividend, action_id ct:<id>
forward and reverse splits → split; any other type kept lower-cased,
action_id ca:<id>
inserted de-duplicated on action_id
any failure: a warning, the run goes on
3. trades, per account
watermark = newest executed_at stored for the account
all fills TWS retains are fetched;
those at or after the watermark are kept
inserted de-duplicated on exec_id
timestamps stored as naive Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)

g.text: holdings = tickers whose summed quantity ≠ 0 on the snapshot date

text.tspan: valuation: the analyze stage with config/assumptions/TICKER.yaml when present
→ intrinsic value per share, newest close on or before the snapshot date, red narrative flags
cannot value: all three unknown
currency table from config/currencies.yaml, loaded once per run
gates: screener inputs built as the screen builds them
(companies, financials_annual, prices_daily, currencies,
damodaran_industry, damodaran_country)
failed gates = the gates that fail; a skipped rule does not count
sector weighted average cost of capital (WACC) from the sector benchmark
no sector benchmark row: sector WACC unknown, gates judged without it
ticker not in companies: failed gates and sector WACC unknown
holding_marks: one row per holding;
the snapshot date's rows deleted, then inserted
unknown values stored empty
previous snapshot = newest snapshot_date before today; none on the first run
positions summed per ticker across accounts
derived events diff the two persisted marks, never a recomputation
position_opened
quantity ≠ 0 now, absent or 0 in the previous snapshot
or held in both with the other sign (a flip)
first run: every position
position_closed
quantity ≠ 0 in the previous snapshot, absent or 0 now
or held in both with the other sign (a flip), fired first
(an account that returns no positions closes each of its
holdings no other account holds)
position_size_changed: held in both, same sign, and
|Δquantity ÷ |previous quantity|| > 10%
exactly 10%: no event
currency_changed
the ticker's portfolio_snapshots currency
(the position's currency IBKR reports: its listing currency at the broker)
differs from the previous snapshot's, both known;
compared per (account, ticker): one event per account whose currency changed;
an account holding it on one side only: nothing
not on the first run
dividend
a corporate_actions row of type dividend for a holding,
effective after the previous snapshot, on or before this one
first run: every action on or before this one
split
the same rule for type split (first run included)
new_filing
a filings_log row of a holding, filed on or before this snapshot,
filed after the previous snapshot or ingested on or after its date,
not reported before: (ticker, filing type, filing date)
absent from events_log
first run: every unreported filing
intrinsic_value_crossed_price
(intrinsic value − price) < 0 before and > 0 now, or > 0 before and < 0 now
equality is not a cross
no previous mark, or any of the four values unknown: nothing
new_red_flag: one per narrative flag red now
and not red in the last known mark
unknown previous flags: the known mark before it is used
no known mark: every red flag is new
unknown flags now: nothing
below_quality_gate: one per gate failing now and not failing before
failed gates unknown on either side, or no previous mark: nothing
sector_recalibrated: |sector WACC now − sector WACC before| > 100 bps
exactly 100 bps: no event; either unknown: nothing
concentration: market value ÷ total market value > 15%, exactly 15%: no event
total over positions with a market value > 0
not a diff: fires on every run while above

g.text: Not events, by design (spec §8.3): price moves and news.

text.tspan: append every event to events_log:
event_type, ticker, previous and current snapshot dates, details
portfolio.md, the full state: positions, profit and loss (P&L), concentration,
suggested reviews
P&L = market value − quantity × average cost; unpriced: P&L unknown
concentration weight = market value ÷ total of positions with a market value > 0;
flagged above 15%
suggested review: each flagged position, consider trimming
--history: P&L per snapshot; --concentration: the breakdown list
alerts.md, today's events only: type, ticker, details
always written; an empty file when there are no events
which channel? BOT_NOTIFIER
none: nothing is sent
email: needs BOT_SMTP_HOST, BOT_SMTP_FROM, BOT_SMTP_TO
telegram: needs BOT_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, BOT_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
a missing setting, or a password in cleartext:
exit code 2, before the sync
send alerts.md?
no channel, or a blank file: not sent
else its text is sent; a send failure: exit code 1
a same-day re-run sends the same alerts again

g.text: Gap: ADR 0005 (Implemented): §4 and the price conversion (#222) are done; the rest of §1–§3, such as §1 (one currency column per concept), is not. The universe is US-only, so every close in prices_daily is in USD and no real data exercises the cross-currency branch today.
Gap: the Flex importer was written from IBKR's documentation against a synthetic fixture and is not yet verified against a real pull (issue 110).

An unknown current value never fires an event. An unknown red-flag set is skipped as a baseline and never fires new_red_flag; new_red_flag compares with the last known mark, an earlier mark whose flags are known. Unknown previous gates or sector WACC fire nothing.
Gap: plano events card says dividend and split cannot fire because nothing feeds them; the Flex importer fills corporate_actions.
Gap: spec §8.3 also lists other corporate actions; mergers, spin-offs and the rest are stored but fire no event.

Gap: spec §8.3 and the plano monitor card say a new filing auto-runs bot analyze. Verified in run_portfolio and the command: nothing reacts to new_filing; mark_holdings re-values every holding each run; no analysis report is written.
In practice only growth_reinvestment can fire it, or hypergrowth_story for a company with hypergrowth signals and no story file (see analyze flags).
A second run on the same day diffs against the same previous snapshot, so it appends the same events again and sends them again; only new_filing is checked against events_log.
